name: MuEP
description: MuEP is a comprehensive multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate embodied agents' reasoning and planning abilities in complex environments with multimodal observations and multi-turn interactions. It includes fine-grained evaluation metrics to assess performance throughout each task and highlights the gap in embodied planning abilities between textual and visual representations.
reputation: A specialized embodied-agent benchmark that is useful for studying multimodal planning and interaction, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on embodied planning with foundation models; evaluates multi-turn interactions and multimodal observations.
